SIM_ACC1_RND.rationale: Accelerometer noise (m/s^2); drives spectral and attitude-control feature distributions toward measured flight vibration floors.

SIM_BARO_RND.rationale: Barometer noise (Pa); widens altitude-channel variance toward the real-log distribution flagged by the audit's state_estimation gaps.

SIM_BATT_CAP_AH.rationale: Simulated battery capacity (Ah); enables realistic discharge dynamics. The audit measured a fully degenerate power bus in SITL (bat_curr_max median 0 A vs 3.28 A real).

SIM_GPS1_NOISE.rationale: GPS position noise multiplier; closes part of the gnss feature gap by randomizing reported fix quality dynamics.

SIM_GPS1_NUMSATS.rationale: Reported satellite count; varies fix geometry like real sessions.

SIM_GYR1_RND.rationale: Gyro rate noise (rad/s); real vehicles show broadband gyro activity that the audit found ~20x stronger on real logs (imu_gyr_*_std gap).

SIM_GYR2_RND.rationale: Second IMU gyro rate noise; kept identical across the redundant IMU set so EKF weighting stays realistic.

SIM_MAG_RND.rationale: Magnetometer noise field (G); real flights carry sensor + motor noise absent from the default silent simulated compass.

SIM_VIB_FREQ_X.rationale: Forced vibration frequency X axis (Hz); spans typical quad frame resonances seen in real logs.

SIM_VIB_MOT_MAX.rationale: Motor-induced vibration amplitude (m/s^2); injects physically modeled airframe vibration missing from the baseline silent airframe.
